## Summary

Sumit Karki is a software engineering student at the University of Wisconsin–Green Bay (UWGB, also written UW-Green Bay or UW–Green Bay) in Green Bay, Wisconsin. Expected graduation: May 2028. GPA: 3.82 / 4.00.

He is a Student Web Developer in UWGB’s Division of Information Technology and works on the university’s public website, uwgb.edu. He co-authored ICMLA 2026 research on pixel-level pavement distress assessment (arXiv:2605.26095). He is Vice President of GDG on Campus UW–Green Bay, Equity & Diversity Chair for the Student Government Association (from September 2026), and lead organizer for HackGB.

He is open to internships, research collaborations, and software engineering opportunities.

## Research

Paper: Pixel-Level Pavement Distress Assessment Using Instance Segmentation
Venue: ICMLA 2026
Authors: Dewick, Pyakurel, Yang, Karki, Choudhury, and Murshed
Dataset: UWGB-StreetCrack, 1,540 field images
Method: Mask R-CNN with ResNet-101 FPN
Results: 84.23% precision, 90.04% recall, 87.04% F1
Links:
- https://arxiv.org/html/2605.26095v2
- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.26095
- https://blog.uwgb.edu/log/07/14/faculty-staff/students-and-faculty-publish-roadway-infrastructure-research-in-icmla-2026/
